description:
DTCE Tool Kit brings schedule formatting, construction quantity estimates and engineering calculation sheets into one Windows workspace. Start with dashboard cards for Formatters, Bill of Quantities, Design Sheets and Project Information.

Format beam and slab schedules from DXF files. Estimate reinforced concrete, rebar, earthworks, masonry, doors and windows, roofing and structural steel. Review quantities and backup computations, then export reports to Excel or PDF.

Bill of Quantities includes beam, slab and footing settings, concrete strengths, rebar grades and selectable commercial bar lengths from 6 m to 15 m. Footing reinforcement accepts spacing or a bar count in each direction. Structural steel estimates cover purlins, angle bars, machine bolts, anchor bolts, plates, crossbracing and metal fascia frames, with cutting plans that reuse compatible offcuts from 6 m stock.

Design Sheets includes Splice, Development & Hooks, Purlin Design and Truss Connections. Purlin and connection sheets use the supplied workbook methods and handbook profile dimensions, with stated assumptions, calculation reports and selected STAAD end-force table imports. These sheets perform the listed checks; complete cold-formed member, HSS joint and other omitted limit states require separate verification by the responsible engineer.

Save Bill of Quantities files retain estimate inputs, loaded DXF contents, profile snapshots and computation data. Reopen the saved project without needing the original DXF files. Link Excel for final quantities with stable summary cells and a formatted Bill of Quantities worksheet. Save roof profiles in the app for reuse across projects.

Access is selected by program. Project Information is included with valid access. Engineering inputs, material specifications and calculation results must be reviewed for the actual project.

The Bill of Quantities shows required material totals and their sources. Group Start tabs hold concrete, earthwork, gravel and finish settings. Estimate canopies/ledges and exterior opening mouldings. Flat-bar sections follow the handbook and selected member type. Plate purchase estimates compare feasible sheet layouts and reuse compatible offcuts; thickness is entered in mm.

The Bill of Quantities follows a four-column item/description/quantity/unit format with project headers and source details. Mouldings are grouped by profile and size across door/window perimeters and additional Finishing Works entries. Steel purchase quantities use whole-stock weight in kg; roofing and insulation use purchase area, while flashings, gutters and ridge rolls use purchased stock length. A background Microsoft Store check requires an available update before continuing; offline or unavailable checks allow work.
features: Dashboard workspaces for Formatters, Bill of Quantities, Design Sheets and Project Information.
Beam and slab DXF schedule formatting with grouped schedules and report exports.
Concrete, rebar and formwork takeoffs for beams, slabs and footings.
Footing rebar inputs by spacing or bar count in either direction; excavation, gravel and backfill quantities.
Concrete strength and rebar grade settings, with selectable 6, 7.5, 9, 10.5, 12, 13.5 and 15 m rebar stock lengths.
Separate net wall areas for 100/150 mm CHB, load-bearing CHB, louver blocks and AAC, with linked opening deductions.
Door and window schedules with automatic jamb defaults, standard 45 mm wooden door leaves, hinges and locksets.
Roofing and insulation purchase areas in sq.m.; flashing, gutter and ridge-roll purchase quantities in stock metres.
Purlin, angle-bar and metal fascia purchase weights in kg from 6 m stock, reusing compatible offcuts across rows.
A307/A325 bolt shaft weights from overall length, plate weights by area or dimensions, and diagonal crossbracing weights.
One matching-size turnbuckle per crossbracing line.
Splice, Development & Hooks, Purlin Design and Truss Connections calculation sheets with stated check limits.
Import selected STAAD end-force tables for axial truss connection checks, retaining load-case and member references.
Save full Bill of Quantities projects; link Excel for stable final summary cells and a formatted Bill of Quantities.
Excel and PDF backups, with stable input rows and automatic wrapping for longer details.
Detailed design reports show formulas, substituted values, governing checks and demand/capacity ratios.
Four-column Bill of Quantities with project headers and source details; confirmed Store updates require updating, with offline access.
Moulding totals grouped by profile/size, combining automatic exterior opening perimeters and additional Finishing Works lengths.
Handbook flat-bar sections and steel-plate sheet fitting with compatible offcut reuse and purchase weight in kg.

User.descriptionSuffix: User edition: use the programs included in your approved access.

Admin.descriptionSuffix: Admin edition: includes the Access Code Generator for authorized administrators, with separate program selections and Store certification codes. Existing matching administrator credentials are required for code generation.
features: Admin Access Code Generator with a separate access selection for each program.

releaseNotesByVersion.1.4.33.0: Adds structural steel estimates for purlins, angles, bolts, plates, crossbracing and metal fascia frames, with 6 m cutting plans and compatible offcut reuse. Adds Purlin Design and Truss Connections sheets using workbook methods, handbook profiles and STAAD end-force table imports. Updates Start to dashboard cards and groups Splice, Development & Hooks in one sheet. Combines AAC thicknesses in one tab with separate 100/150 mm totals. Adds applicable roof side-lap choices, reusable app roof profiles, portable Excel/XLSM project data, stable input rows, and 13.50 m and 15 m rebar stock lengths. Calculation reports state supported checks and remaining verification requirements.
releaseNotesByVersion.1.4.34.0: Adds separate access selections for each program, including each Design Sheet, in Windows and iPhone code generators. Design tabs open their sheets automatically. Detailed purlin and truss connection reports show formulas, substituted values, governing cases and demand/capacity ratios. Table headings wrap and resize to display all wording. Cutting allocation runs internally and reuses compatible offcuts across structural steel, reinforcing-bar and roofing-accessory entries. Excel exports final quantities in one worksheet; use Save Bill of Quantities to retain full project inputs, DXF contents, profiles and computations. Invalid exports now identify the input issues to resolve.
releaseNotesByVersion.1.4.35.0: Adds a Bill of Quantities workspace with material source breakdowns. Moves reinforced-concrete, earthwork/gravel and finish-schedule settings into their group Start tabs. Adds canopy/ledge and separate gravel takeoffs, automatic jamb depths from assigned wall thicknesses, and exterior door/window moulding quantities. Adds handbook flat-bar sections filtered by member type, plus plate sheet fitting, compatible offcut reuse and whole-sheet purchase weights. Plate thickness uses mm. Soil defaults apply across the project. Save Bill of Quantities retains complete project data; Excel continues to export final quantities only.
releaseNotesByVersion.1.4.36.0: Adds background Microsoft Store update checks: a confirmed available update requires updating before using tools; offline or unavailable checks allow continued work. Formats the Bill of Quantities with item number, description, quantity and unit columns, project headers and source details. Adds moulding inputs under Finishing Works, grouped by profile/size with automatic exterior door/window lengths. Purlin, angle and metal fascia quantities show kg based on whole 6 m stock after compatible offcut reuse. Roofing and insulation final quantities use purchase area; flashings, gutters and ridge rolls use purchased stock metres. Roll and stock-piece counts remain internal. Existing project formats remain readable.
